proposals.evidence: DEDR 4682 gives Kota maṇḍ and Tulu maṇḍe head, alongside Kannada maṇḍe and the wider maṇṭai skull/head family. Survey Kota manḍə and Tulu manḍa preserve their final vowels. Badaga manḍe and Betta Kurumba maṇḍi are comparative extensions explicitly labelled look-alikes in the source, not literal DEDR attestations. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Betta Kurumba and Ravula kālə are explicitly comparative extensions, labelled look-alikes in the upstream source, not literal DEDR attestations. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3633 explicitly gives Tamil/Malayalam nākku and Toda nōf tongue; survey nākkə/nākə and nōf preserve their spellings. Betta Kurumba nelgi is a comparative extension toward the nālage/nālige series documented in Kannada, explicitly only a look-alike in the source. This does not treat the Betta form as a literal DEDR attestation. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
